newsitem.title: philippines: Manila shares end nearly flat, off day's low.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares end nearly flat, off day's low.

text.p: * Main index closed lower by 0.16 points to 3,222.98
Manila shares finished a shade down on Monday, as a 22-point drop in mid-trade was countered by late buying in choice blue chips, traders said.
"There was a lot of window-dressing since it is the end of the first quarter on blue chips such as San Miguel Corp," said Poch Zamora, dealer at Peregrine Securities.
Allan Araullo of Regina Capital said trading was marred by the Dow Jones' steep fall before the Easter holidays.

"The market was trading very sluggishly at the open and we were feeling the effects of the big drop in the Dow. The market then recovered on bargain-hunting in blue chips," said Jose Ricardo Garcia, executive vice-president at Diversified Securities Inc. On Friday, the Dow tumbled 140 points.
Value turnover was a modest 2.9 billion pesos.

Regina's Araullo said he expects the market to trade in a similar manner on Tuesday until the listing of Equitable Bank on Thursday. Traders were mixed as to where funds will likely be diverted after the bank's listing. Some said blue chips may benefit while others expected gains in third-liners.
"I think we will continue to look at Wall Street for direction in the coming days," said Peregrine's Zamora.
